editions.credit: A careful and strict enquiry into the modern prevailing notions of that freedom of will, in Text Creation Partnership N05663 (Boston: S. Kneeland, 1754). Transcription: Text Creation Partnership (EEBO/Evans/ECCO-TCP), keyed and encoded from page images of the printing named in the header (CC0).
